tax: sales/use: Indiana gasoline use tax (IC 6-2.5-3.5; functions as a sales tax on gasoline)
reduction: rate: full suspension of 7 percent of the statewide average retail price (ex tax), reset monthly
instrument: Energy-emergency orders under IC 10-14-3-13: EO 26-09 (Apr 8), 26-11 (May 6), 26-13 (Jun 3; new emergency eff. Jun 7), 26-16 (Jul 2), 26-20 (Aug 5; new emergency eff. Aug 7), 26-25 (Sep 3), 26-33 (Sep 30; renews Oct 6-Nov 4)
notes: Merged consecutive 30-day orders; DOR says orders run consecutively with no gap and "No Gas Use Tax should be collected from retailers Apr. 8 through Nov. 4". End date is inclusive per EO 26-33 ("through November 4, 2026") and the DOR page. Continuation past Nov 4 needs a new order (watch). EO 26-09, 26-16 and 26-25 were not fetched (guessed PDF filenames returned 404); their content is taken from DOR Departmental Notice 45 (Jul 2) and the recitals of EO 26-20/26-33. Sales Tax Institute cites "EO 26-28" for the Sep 30 order; the DOR link and OCR of the order show EO 26-33. EO scans have no text layer (OCR). Legality of repeated renewals was questioned in press (secondary).

tax: excise: Kentucky motor fuels tax (gasoline, LP, special fuels; 1.4 c Petroleum Environmental Assurance Fee not reduced)
reduction: cents_per_gal: 10 c reduction (gasoline 25.0 to 15.0 c; special fuels 22.0 to 12.0 c)
instrument: EO 2026-235 (signed May 5; state of emergency under KRS 39A.090, effective May 11, 30-day term to Jun 10)
notes: Statewide period. No primary document could be stored: governor.ky.gov returned HTTP 403 to the project client, apps.legislature.ky.gov timed out, and revenue.ky.gov answered with a redirect that PoliteClient refuses to follow. Dates rest on consistent secondaries (KLC, LEX18, Spectrum, Avalara; KSM says only "until further notice" and is stale; search excerpts of Bloomberg Tax not stored). LEX18/Spectrum: statutory 30-day term ends Wed Jun 10, areas without an extension request see prices rise Thu Jun 11. The Revenue Department rate page (read once with WebFetch, not stored) lists gasoline 25.0 c, special fuels 22.0 c "effective July 1, 2026", i.e. the pre-cut level. Outside the w21 and sa windows, inside the ky12 span. The same order froze the July 1 formula increase (not counted; see borderline cases). A separate Oct 7 2026 order (dyed diesel enforcement only) is not a tax change.
